name: Polina Morozova
source:
Polina is a slender and beautiful twelve—year-old girl. Her hair is long, black and straight, and her eyes are deep blue. In most cases, she has a cheerful, affectionate expression and a friendly smile. Polina is distinguished by her refined, refined gestures, and she smells pleasantly of blackberries.

At school, she usually wears a white shirt with a black vest and a blue tie, a skirt, strappy shoes, and stud earrings. On the street, Polina wears a brown coat with a belt and six rows of buttons, black boots with fur trim, knitted turquoise mittens with a rope pattern on her hands and a turquoise hat with a pompom on top. He often carries a violin in a black case.
